data.text: Good, I understand the structure. The key insight is that `orders.customer_id` links to `customers.customer_id`, but to identify a person across orders, I need to use `customers.customer_unique_id`. Let me run the SQL query to count orders per person and filter for those with more than one order.

args.purpose: Count number of people who placed more than one order (all statuses included)
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) as customers_with_multiple_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
